messages:
Ana: That all-hands hit different today, lowkey teared up at the roadmap demo :sob: :rocket:
Devon: same. shoutout to infra for the latency numbers — jaw drop emoji :mind_blown:
Omar: can we get that benchmark slide in the handbook pls? wanna flex to partners :sunglasses:
Lina: putting it in #docs-updates after lunch. also: who stole my leftover bagel from the kitchen? :bagel: :thinking_face:
Marcus: not me, but i will confess to eating the cookie next to it. it was tragic and delicious :cookie:
Emily: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/cheer-ovation-3o6gbbuLW76jkt8vIc — for the applause part :clap:
Kai: Tiny poll: who’s in for post-all-hands virtual pizza tonight? reply with :pizza: or :no_entry:
Ana: :pizza: — count me in, my oven's taking a night off
Devon: :pizza: but only if we have pineapple-free zones agreed? :grimacing:
Omar: :no_entry: pineapple is a hill i will die on (hot take)
Lina: can we do two pizzas: one adventurous, one classic? consensus-building 101 :laughing:
ops-bot: Reminder: office pantry restock scheduled tomorrow at 10am. Please label personal food.
Marcus: Also, tiny kudos: shoutout to Lina for running a tight Q&A — silky transitions :sparkles:
Emily: Also also: someone make a clip of the cat cameo during CEO's demo. mandatory meme material. :cat2:
Kai: I clipped it, posting in #random in 2m — brace for maximum cuteness
Ana: Ok but seriously can we have a follow-up thread with suggested topics for the next all-hands? I have a strong opinion about a 'show-and-tell' 10-min slot :raised_hands:
Devon: +1 show-and-tell. also more snack diversity pls :joy:
Omar: last note: new hire welcome shoutout — welcome @Sam (marketing)! we missed you at all-hands, catch the replay. :tada:
Lina: Welcome Sam! cake emoji when you're in the office so we can bribe them into org trivia :cake:
Emily: Thread summary: big wins, snacks, cat cameo, pizza poll, and Lina is definitely a hero. Good vibes all around :sparkling_heart:
